name: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc.
old_description: Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling was founded in 2009 with the aspiration to become the Premier plastic injection molding supplier in the Southeast.  The owners of Premier Plastic, Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, came together bringing their combined experiences in injection molding to form a plastic manufacturing company with a focus on quality and service.  We are always committed to promoting our outstanding reputation by treating our customers with integrity and excellence.
about:
Premier Plastic Molding & Tooling, Inc. was founded in 2009 in Winder, Georgia, just northeast of Atlanta. The company was established by Scott Dittman and Phillip Sparks, who combined their experience in injection molding to create a plastic manufacturing business focused on quality and service. The founders aimed to become the leading injection molding supplier in the Southeast.

The company provides custom injection molding, tooling, and product development services. It assists entrepreneurs and inventors in taking concepts from prototype or sketch through to production. Premier Plastic offers quick turnaround on orders and operates stocking programs to ensure customers have parts when needed. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Premier Plastic serves a range of customers, from individual entrepreneurs and inventors to businesses requiring custom molded plastic components. The company does not specify particular industry sectors in its public materials.

The founders started the business with the aspiration to be the premier injection molding supplier in the region, emphasizing integrity, excellence, and personalized service regardless of order volume. The company highlights its American-owned and operated status and over 40 years of combined molding experience as key differentiators.
